lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 11 — Peter Explains His Actions / The Church at Antioch

questions.questionText: Who criticized Peter when he went up to Jerusalem?
What did they say Peter did?
options: You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them

questions.questionText: How did Peter explain?
options: He told them the whole story of the vision and Cornelius

questions.questionText: Peter said the sheet vision happened how many times?
How many believers went with Peter to Caesarea?
Peter said the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on whom?
Peter remembered Jesus saying, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with _____.”
Peter asked, “Who was I to think that I could stand in God’s way?” What had God given the Gentiles?
options: The same gift he gave us who believed

questions.questionText: When they heard this they had no further objections. What did they say?
options: So then, even to Gentiles God has granted repentance that leads to life

questions.questionText: Those scattered by the persecution traveled as far as where, spreading the word?
Men from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and began to speak to whom?
options: Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus

questions.questionText: What happened as they preached?
options: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed

questions.questionText: The church in Jerusalem sent whom to Antioch?
What kind of man was Barnabas?
options: A good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith

questions.questionText: Barnabas went to look for Saul in which city?
For how long did Barnabas and Saul meet with the church in Antioch?
What were the disciples called first at Antioch?
I am a prophet who came down from Jerusalem to Antioch and predicted a famine. Who am I?
When did that famine happen?
What did the disciples decide to do?
options: Provide help for the brothers and sisters living in Judea

questions.questionText: They sent their gift by whom?
True or false: Peter said he was not to call anyone impure or unclean.
options: True — that is what he told them in the story

questions.questionText: The angel told Cornelius to send to Joppa. Peter retold this in chapter 11. Where was the house?
options: Simon the tanner’s house by the sea in Joppa

questions.questionText: Who said the angel told Cornelius Peter would bring a message by which he and his household would be saved?
options: Peter quoting Cornelius’s men / the angel’s words

questions.questionText: What did Barnabas see in Antioch that made him glad?
options: What the grace of God had done

questions.questionText: Barnabas encouraged them to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts. Who was he?
options: Barnabas, the good man sent from Jerusalem

questions.questionText: A great number of people were brought to the Lord by whose help in Antioch?
I predicted a famine over the entire Roman world. Who am I?
I am the emperor during whose reign the famine happened.
Help was sent to brothers and sisters living where?
I went with Barnabas to take the gift to the elders. Who am I?
Disciples were first called Christians in which city?
True or false: At first those scattered told the message only to Jews.
options: True — and they never told Greeks later

questions.questionText: Who began to speak to Greeks in Antioch?
News of this reached the church in which city?
Peter said, “Who was I to think that I could stand in God’s _____?”
Who praised God after Peter’s explanation?
options: The circumcised believers who had criticized him

questions.questionText: Barnabas and Saul taught great numbers of people in which church for a year?
I am one of the prophets who came from Jerusalem to Antioch. Who am I named?
True or false: Each disciple gave as he or she was able.
options: True — but they gave to Caesar
